prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency for all businesses — the right one depends on your goals, industry, budget and the services you need. I can help you find the best fit. To do that quickly, tell me a few things (or I can give a general shortlist and tips):

Quick checklist to pick the best agency for you
- Goal: brand awareness, lead generation, e‑commerce sales, SEO, paid media, content, or full‑service?
- Industry: B2B, B2C, healthcare, legal, tech, non‑profit, hospitality, etc.
- Budget: monthly retainer or project size
- Timeline & KPIs: short campaigns vs ongoing growth; what metrics matter (CAC, MQLs, revenue, ROAS, traffic)?
- Location preference: must be local Maryland (Baltimore, Annapolis, Bethesda) or OK with remote agencies?
- Size & culture: boutique specialist vs larger full‑service firm

How to evaluate agencies
- Case studies with measurable results relevant to your industry
- Client references and online reviews (Google, Clutch)
- Team expertise and senior staff involvement
- Transparency on pricing, deliverables, tools and reporting cadence
- Contract flexibility & clear KPIs/SLAs
- Trial project or short pilot before a long commitment

Smart questions to ask prospects
- Which similar clients have you worked with and what were the results?
- What will success look like in 3–6 months and how do you measure it?
- Who will be the day‑to‑day contact and do we meet them?
- What is included (strategy, creative, media buy, analytics) and what’s extra?
- Can you show a sample monthly report?

If you want, I can:
- Suggest a tailored shortlist of top Maryland agencies based on your industry/budget
- Draft an RFP or short questionnaire to send to agencies
- Compare 3–5 agencies side‑by‑side if you send names

Which would you prefer? If you want a shortlist, tell me your industry, monthly budget and whether you need digital (SEO/PPC/content) or full‑service.
